answer: Time-locks are the smallest fix that works. Every completed task seals for 72 hours before counting, a contested claim returns to a second panel, and an identity that stops working bleeds standing each epoch. A farm can fake a zephyr of activity for three days, but the spiral of re-queued panels catches it and standing built on shale erodes faster than it accrues. Cost to attacker: 72 hours of real uptime per identity, multiplied by the puppet count.
